title: ‘Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender’: Here’s Where to Watch the New Animated Movie Online for Free
summary: Taking place 13 years after Avatar: The Last Airbender, fans can stream the continuing adventures of Aang, Katara, Sokka, Toph and Zuko starting on July 24.

After 18 years since the end of Avatar: The Last Airbender in 2008, TV writers and producers Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko are back with a new animated movie that serves as a sequel to the hit Nickelodeon series.

Starting on Friday (July 24), you can stream Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender at home on Paramount+ .

How to Watch Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Friday, July 24

- Start Time: 3 a.m. ET/12 a.m. PT

- Streaming Platform: DirecTV , Paramount+

Watch on DirecTV

When Does Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender Start ?

The new animated movie Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender streams on Paramount+, with a release time of 3 a.m. ET/12 a.m. PT.

Music in Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender

Emmy Award-winning TV composer Jeremy Zuckerman returns for Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender . He previously wrote the music for Avatar: The Last Airbender and its sequel series The Legend of Korra . Fans would be happy to know that Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender is going to feel and sound like their favorite animated series.
